subject: Warm Intro: Finova — AWS co-sell alignment and procurement runway
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Nydia Alvarez <nydia.alvarez@amazon.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Warm Intro: Finova — AWS co-sell alignment and procurement runway

Hi Nydia —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. As discussed, Id love to get a short intro between you, us (Redwood), and the Finova team to align on an AWS co-sell plan and procurement timeline. Finova is evaluating a market-facing deployment and wants to understand: marketplace listing timing, co-sell support, and procurement steps for an enterprise contract.

Proposed goals for an initial 30-min call:
- Quick intros (AWS/Finova/Redwood)
- High-level success metrics and timeline for marketplace enablement
- Procurement runway: PO vs. marketplace purchase vs. reseller path
- Next steps: mutual action plan owner assignments

Could you introduce Samir (Finova product lead) and Helen (procurement) and help suggest an AWS GTM rep who should join? Ive attached a draft mutual action plan and our marketplace checklist to make the intro efficient.

Suggested times (PST):
- Wed 8/5 10:00-10:30
- Thu 8/6 09:00-09:30
- Fri 8/7 14:00-14:30

If none of these work, happy to accommodate.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199

Attachments: Finova-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-aws-marketplace-checklist.pdf (pdf)

------------------------------------------------------------

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Warm Intro: Finova — AWS co-sell alignment and procurement runway

Hi Kimberly,

Happy to connect. Hi Samir and Helen (looping you both in)  hello from AWS GTM. Samir, Finova sounds like a strong fit for the ISV co-sell program. We can walk through marketplace listing options (private offers vs. AWS Marketplace SaaS) and coordinate with procurement on commercial pathing.

I can join the kickoff and bring our Marketplace enablement rep (cc'd internally). Proposed: Wed 8/5 10:00 PST works for me. If that aligns for you all, Kimberly, please send calendar invite and a short agenda.

Best,
Nydia Alvarez
Senior Partner Lead, AWS
nydia.alvarez@amazon.com

- Can Redwood send a one-page summary of the recommended billing paths (marketplace SaaS vs. marketplace private offer vs. direct PO)?

Thanks all  calendar invite sent for Wed 8/5 10:00 PST (see calendar). Quick note post-call: productive conversation, agreed owners and next steps below.

Call summary / agreed next steps:
- Marketplace path: start with AWS Marketplace private offer to enable procurement quickly; evaluate SaaS listing in parallel (owner: Kimberly)
- Technical deep dive: Karthik to schedule a 60-min demo + integration discussion with Finova engineering (owner: karthik_iyer)
- Account mapping & co-sell plan: Laura to draft joint account plan and define target personas & success metrics (owner: laura_bennett)
- Procurement & contract: initial procurement runway via private offer; Helen to confirm internal PO timeline (owner: Helen Cho)
- Timeline: aim to have private offer draft and technical validation by 9/10 to support a September marketplace cadence (deal_id: D-2026-0371)

Attachments: updated Finova-MAP-v1.xlsx (Ive added owners & dates), redwood-aws-marketplace-checklist.pdf
Shared doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1FinovaMAP
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Action items assigned in thread:
- Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwood.com): schedule technical deep dive with Finova eng by 8/14
- Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.com): draft joint account plan by 8/12 and share for review
- Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwood.com): prepare private offer template and intro to Redwood legal for contract pathing

If anyone needs to flag blockers (procurement concerns, security checklist items), add them to the shared doc and well triage.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to momentum here.

Best,
